verdict.rationale: Heap documents an official web install snippet and a general cross-platform tracking goal. Backend events can be sent through server-side track and bulk-track HTTP endpoints (up to 1000 events per request), which is a raw API rather than language SDKs. The pack does not name any mobile SDKs or backend language SDKs. Missing for 10: documented iOS/Android/React Native/Flutter mobile SDKs, official backend SDKs for major languages (e.g. Node, Python, Ruby, Java), independent corroboration of multi-platform SDK coverage.
